title: " Correspondances " fonctorielles. Dualité des topos : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

errors: No mathematical error. The right-hand side of the second formula lacks the subscript B (it should read ⟨Ψ_*, f^∘_!(Φ^*)⟩_B); this is a notational omission in the manuscript itself.

ideas.what: Canonical pairing between presheaves and copresheaves on A via the tensor product / coend ∫^a Φ_*(a)×Φ^*(a)
ideas.modern_name: Tensor product of functors (coend); composition of profunctors 1 ⇸ A ⇸ 1
ideas.usually_credited_to: Kan (1958); Yoneda; Bénabou and Lawvere for distributors/profunctors
ideas.where_published: Tensor products of this kind are used in SGA 4 (Exposé I/IV, Kan extensions and flat functors); the exact form is unsure.

ideas.what: Reciprocity formulas: f_! is transpose to restriction f^{∘*}, and restriction f^* is transpose to f^∘_!, for the presheaf/copresheaf pairing
ideas.modern_name: Coend Fubini / co-Yoneda: (Lan_f Φ) ⊗_B Ψ ≅ Φ ⊗_A (Ψ∘f); mutual adjointness of Kan extension and restriction under the profunctor pairing
ideas.usually_credited_to: Standard category theory (Kan; Mac Lane, CWM ch. X; Bénabou's distributors)
ideas.where_published: Implicit in SGA 4 Exposé I (f_!, f^*, Kan extensions)

deep.surprise_reason: The page contains only two standard coend reciprocity isomorphisms, written as notation-fixing for the dual pair A^∧/A^∨. They are correct and well known. The more interesting construction, the triples (H_*, H^*, α), which resembles an Isbell-envelope-type object, is on the next page, not this one.
transcription_corrections: The circled '(4)' above 'A^∧ A^∨' is the sheet number of the series, not a formula label.
The symbols written as fancy Φ are Φ (capital phi), paired with Ψ; the transcription is consistent with this.
The second line should read ⟨f^*(Ψ_*), Φ^*⟩_A ≃ ⟨Ψ_*, f^∘_!(Φ^*)⟩; there is no subscript B in the image either.
The struck-out word at the top right is illegible and crossed out; it is not part of the boxed formulas.
There is a curved stroke linking A^∧ and A^∨ at the top left, apparently indicating the duality pairing.
